name: parabank_login
description: Log in with the given username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page

steps.intent: Enter the username into the username field
steps.action: Locate the username input field (e9) under the 'Customer Login' heading and type the supplied username value into it.

steps.intent: Enter the password into the password field
steps.action: Locate the password input field (e10) and type the supplied password value into it.
Click the 'Log In' button (e11) to submit the credentials.

steps.intent: Confirm the Accounts Overview page has loaded
steps.action: Verify that the page transitions to the Accounts Overview page, confirming successful login.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to the ParaBank application.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to the ParaBank application.

approved_plan.success_signal: The Accounts Overview page is displayed, showing a heading such as "Accounts Overview" and the authenticated user's account summary table, confirming a successful login.
